title: Bigelow tells Fox 'they're walking among us'

tellings.quote: And then he goes he goes, "Uh, yeah, and they're walking among us."

plain: The story is that in Las Vegas in 2009, a man named Bigelow told James Fox, plainly, "they're walking among us," meaning beings from elsewhere. Fox tells it himself, as the person who heard it, and links it to his film I Know What I Saw. If true, a well-placed figure was saying that non-human beings are already living among people.
